how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darkshore-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:729:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ south and check on Prospector Remtravel.
rows.quest:729:details:0: What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in ⟦E2⟧ everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.
rows.quest:729:details:1: BBut the prospector is rather... um... oblivious ...to his surroundings.
rows.quest:729:details:2: BWe had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. I ran back to Auberdine for help.
rows.quest:729:details:3: BPlease travel south and see if the prospector is okay!
rows.quest:729:completion:0: Hollee. is that you? I need some help chiseling this stone. Hand me my stone brush, I think I see something.
rows.quest:729:completion:1: BHey, you're not Hollee! Don't suppose you've seen my stone brush?
rows.quest:729:completion:2: BNever mind that now! I promised the League I'd send the mysterious fossil I found. Where did Hollee go?
rows.quest:729:completion:3: BSo much work to be done! Now where is that mysterious fossil... and my brush... and Hollee...
rows.quest:729:completion:4: BAnd who are you... 'tis no matter, so long as you're here to help.
rows.quest:729:completion:5: BLet me know when you're ready to start looking.
rows.quest:731:obj:0: Protect Prospector Remtravel as he searches for the mysterious fossil, then return to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.
rows.quest:731:details:0: So then, Hollee... oh that's right, you are not Hollee. Where's Hollee?
rows.quest:731:details:1: BBah, that's beside the point. We must find that stone brush... I mean the mysterious fossil! We must find that fossil. The Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧ will want some indication as to what I've been doing.
rows.quest:731:details:2: BLet me know when you are ready and we will hunt down that brush.... I mean fossil! We shall find something in writing to satisfy the League.
rows.quest:731:completion:0: Thank the stars Prospector Remtravel is safe! I told you he was absent minded. I can't believe he insisted on staying there with all of those horrible creatures lurking about.
rows.quest:741:obj:0: Take the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:741:details:0: So the prospector wants to send the mysterious fossil to the Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧? I don't feel right leaving ⟦E4⟧ without him.
rows.quest:741:details:1: BHere, ⟦1⟧, deliver the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:741:completion:0: Oh my! Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
rows.quest:942:obj:0: Take the mysterious fossil to Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:942:details:0: This fossil bears a striking resemblance to one I once saw in ⟦E2⟧. An archaeologist by the name of Flagongut brought it to our annual Explorers' League conference. He believed the fossil had a power which could be unlocked somehow.
rows.quest:942:details:1: BLast I heard Flagongut had holed up in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil ⟦E5⟧, awaiting escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. Seek him out and show him Remtravel's fossil. Perhaps he can reveal the secrets of the past.
rows.quest:942:details:2: BThe ship to Menethil departs from Auberdine.
rows.quest:942:completion:0: Oh my! You say this came from the distant lands of ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:943:obj:0: Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil ⟦E5⟧ wants you to bring him the Stone of Relu and Flagongut's Fossil.
rows.quest:943:details:0: Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the ⟦E7⟧. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.
rows.quest:943:details:1: BWhile I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.
rows.quest:943:details:2: BBring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.
rows.quest:943:completion:1: BNow to see if I can use the stone to decipher the powers of the fossils.
rows.quest:944:obj:0: Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl. Use the bowl to speak with Onu.
rows.quest:944:details:0: It is strange that the naga are here, in ⟦E4⟧. But stranger still...are the Twilight's ⟦E8⟧. That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth. Lords defeated long ago.
rows.quest:944:details:1: BThe Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.
rows.quest:944:details:2: BGo there and look for more Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ cultists.
rows.quest:944:details:3: BTake this phial of scrying. Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive. Then speak to me through the bowl.
rows.quest:944:completion:0: The Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ is at the Master's Glaive?
rows.quest:944:completion:2: BThe old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.
rows.quest:944:completion:3: BThe Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ must be seeking this power.
rows.quest:945:obj:0: Help Therylune escape, then tell Therysil at the Shrine of Aessina that her sister is safe.
rows.quest:945:details:1: BI was wandering around the Master's Glaive, and these dirty cultists surrounded me. Lucky I'm good at hiding!!
rows.quest:945:details:2: BCan you help me out of here? And I need to send word to my sister Therysil that I'm all right. She's in ⟦E9⟧ to the south, at the Shrine of Aessina.
rows.quest:945:completion:0: My sister was where?? Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still! That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...
rows.quest:945:completion:1: BWell thank you, ⟦3⟧. It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
rows.quest:947:obj:0: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
rows.quest:947:details:0: I am devising a potion that requires rare ⟦E10⟧, ⟦E10⟧ that grow only in a certain cave. The cave lies behind ⟦E11⟧, to the east and slightly north along the mountains.
rows.quest:947:details:1: BI would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place. Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:947:details:2: BPlease, ⟦4⟧, gather the ⟦E10⟧ for me. And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
rows.quest:947:completion:0: Many thanks, ⟦5⟧. These ⟦E10⟧ are fine specimens!
rows.quest:947:completion:1: BAnd when you were at ⟦E11⟧, did you find anything to confirm the warnings of the Ancients?
rows.quest:947:completion:2: BThe Ancients are wise, but I had hoped that, this time, they were wrong.
rows.quest:948:obj:0: Speak with Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
rows.quest:948:details:0: Onu, an Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients, knows of your journey to Cliffwater Falls and wishes to speak with you. The grove lies to the south, nestled near the mountains.
rows.quest:948:details:1: BThe Ancients are patient and wise, ⟦6⟧. But if Onu seeks your counsel concerning what you saw in the falls, then I fear it is urgent.
rows.quest:948:completion:2: BWe have matters...to discuss. You and I.
rows.quest:949:obj:0: Find a clue in the Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ camp at the Master's Glaive.
rows.quest:949:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E8⟧'s purpose at the Master's Glaive is not known. But it must be dark.
rows.quest:949:details:1: BSearch through their camp at the Glaive... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions.
rows.quest:949:details:2: BFor we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
rows.quest:949:completion:0: This book is hand printed in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist.
rows.quest:950:obj:0: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.
rows.quest:950:details:0: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
rows.quest:950:details:1: BTearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
rows.quest:950:completion:0: A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.
rows.quest:950:completion:1: BLet us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E4⟧...
rows.quest:951:obj:0: Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
rows.quest:951:details:0: The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves! It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's ⟦E8⟧, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.
rows.quest:951:details:1: BTravel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones. Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's ⟦E8⟧ intends to exploit the magic of the elves.
rows.quest:951:completion:0: Thank you. These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone. That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain. Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...
rows.quest:953:obj:0: Study the tablets which tell of Ameth'Aran and of its fall, then return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:953:details:0: To the east you will find the ruins of Ameth'Aran. It is now inhabited by the restless spirits of the Highborne that once dwelt within its walls, but once it was a place where the servants of ⟦E12⟧ freely practiced their powerful magics.
rows.quest:953:details:1: BI was sent to explore the ruins and came across two large tablets, scrawled with the stories of Ameth'Aran and its fall. While I read the runes, I was accosted by the spirits, and fled.
rows.quest:953:details:2: BPlease, if you can, venture to the ruins and decipher the tablets in my place.
rows.quest:953:completion:0: We have few records from the time around the War of the Ancients, especially near the destruction of the ⟦E13⟧. Given the upheaval and cataclysmic events that were taking place, it is no big surprise.
rows.quest:953:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦9⟧. With your help, my work here is finished, and I will be able to deliver a full report to the Circle.
rows.quest:954:obj:0: Find the source of the strange blue aura in the ruins of Bashal'Aran.
rows.quest:954:details:0: The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.
rows.quest:954:details:1: BEven with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.
rows.quest:954:details:2: BI would like you to investigate it.
rows.quest:954:completion:0: Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a ⟦10⟧ such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.
rows.quest:954:completion:1: BBut please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
rows.quest:955:obj:0: Acquire 8 Grell Earrings for Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
rows.quest:955:details:0: If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.
rows.quest:955:details:1: BI am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
rows.quest:955:completion:0: Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... however they have come into contact with it recently. Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
rows.quest:956:obj:0: Obtain the Ancient Moonstone Seal and bring it to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
rows.quest:956:details:0: If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.
rows.quest:956:details:1: BI feel strongly that this must be true, ⟦11⟧. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
rows.quest:956:completion:0: It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, ⟦12⟧. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
rows.quest:957:obj:0: Destroy the Ancient Moonstone Seal at the ancient flame in Ameth'Aran, then return to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
rows.quest:957:details:0: It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. In this flame this seal could be destroyed.
rows.quest:957:completion:0: I am freed, ⟦14⟧! I can now see with my own eyes the changes that have come to our world... Only bits and pieces have I known. To think that when I last walked freely, the Well still stood and the Highborne held court with ⟦E12⟧, our beloved queen.
rows.quest:957:completion:1: BI sense that my jailor, my former master, Athrikus, still lives... Already my feelings of hopelessness will give way into thoughts of vengeance.
rows.quest:958:obj:0: Retrieve 7 Highborne Relics for Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
rows.quest:958:details:0: ⟦15⟧. A task I would ask of you.
rows.quest:958:details:1: BHave you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.
rows.quest:958:details:2: BI have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
rows.quest:958:completion:0: Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
rows.quest:963:obj:0: Free the spirit of Anaya Dawnrunner and bring her pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Auberdine.
rows.quest:963:details:0: In the aftermath of the battles at the ⟦E13⟧, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.
rows.quest:963:details:1: BI would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of ⟦E4⟧ in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.
rows.quest:963:details:2: BShe must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
rows.quest:963:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦16⟧. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.
rows.quest:963:completion:1: BPlease, I would be alone with my grief...
rows.quest:965:obj:0: Find Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:965:details:0: Hail, young ⟦17⟧. I am Elissa Starbreeze, and it is my charge to protect Auberdine from harm.
rows.quest:965:details:1: BTo this end, I sent Balthule Shadowstrike to observe the strange happenings around the Tower of Althalaxx to the northeast.
rows.quest:965:details:2: BIt is past time that he should have returned. I worry that he has encountered some unforeseen danger in the forest. I would be most appreciative if you would find him and see that he is doing well.
rows.quest:965:completion:0: Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
rows.quest:966:obj:0: Collect 4 Worn Parchments for Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:966:details:0: A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.
rows.quest:966:details:1: BDelgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.
rows.quest:966:details:2: BA few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
rows.quest:966:completion:0: Many thanks, ⟦18⟧. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...
rows.quest:966:completion:1: BHmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.
rows.quest:966:completion:2: BThere is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
rows.quest:967:obj:0: Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in ⟦E9⟧ Forest.
rows.quest:967:details:0: My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the ⟦E14⟧ and the art of battle.
rows.quest:967:details:1: BDelgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.
rows.quest:967:details:2: BYou will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in ⟦E9⟧ Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
rows.quest:967:completion:0: If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...
rows.quest:967:completion:1: BThis is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.
rows.quest:967:completion:2: BAt first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
rows.quest:968:obj:0: Bring the Book: The Powers Below to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:968:details:0: Although terribly worn and scratched, the title of this book can still be read upon its cover:
rows.quest:968:details:2: BInside the book is a listing of unpronounceable names with foreboding titles, methods of worship, and preferred sacrifices...many of which include living, humanoid creatures.
rows.quest:968:details:3: BOn the inside cover of the book are the words: "Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, The Forlorn Cavern, ⟦E2⟧. Proprietor: Gerrig Bonegrip."
rows.quest:968:details:4: BIf Bonegrip sells books like this, perhaps he'll buy this one back.
rows.quest:968:completion:0: Ah, a copy of The Powers Below. An interesting text, this is. And some might find it useful...
rows.quest:968:completion:1: BBut this one's in sad shape. And look here! There are notes in the margin of almost every page!
rows.quest:968:completion:2: BHm...I know this copy. I sold it to Bolgar last year. Are you...a friend of his? Yes, I thought you were. You have that same fire behind your eyes!
rows.quest:968:completion:3: BWell, by definition, a friend of Bolgar's is a friend of mine. And we take care of our own, yes?
rows.quest:970:obj:0: Collect a Glowing Soul Gem and return it to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:970:details:0: Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.
rows.quest:970:details:1: BBring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
rows.quest:970:completion:0: Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
rows.quest:973:obj:0: Bring Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:973:details:0: Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the ⟦E15⟧ Scar Shrine, a place of great evil in southwestern ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:973:details:1: BHe had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
rows.quest:973:completion:0: It was a grand thing you did today, ⟦19⟧. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
rows.quest:973:completion:1: BNow, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
rows.quest:981:obj:0: Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:981:details:0: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
rows.quest:981:completion:0: I knew you would be up to the task, ⟦20⟧.
rows.quest:981:completion:1: BI sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, ⟦21⟧, as well as this gift.
rows.quest:982:obj:0: Recover the Silver Dawning's Lockbox and the Mist Veil's Lockbox for Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine. Both items should be found aboard the wreckage of the ships to the north of the village.
rows.quest:982:details:0: Off the coast of ⟦E4⟧ to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.
rows.quest:982:details:1: BBoth captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
rows.quest:982:completion:0: You've done us here in Auberdine a great service, lad. We'll make sure that their effects are properly taken care of.
rows.quest:982:completion:1: BAs for you, please have this. It is the least I can do for someone with the bravery to set things right.
rows.quest:983:obj:0: Collect 6 Crawler Legs and place them in Buzzbox 827.
rows.quest:983:details:0: Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!
rows.quest:983:details:1: BMaybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.
rows.quest:983:details:2: BEach one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
rows.quest:983:completion:0: As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.
rows.quest:983:completion:1: B"Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! This is Wizbang by the way! Thanks a lot... Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
rows.quest:984:obj:0: Find a corrupt furbolg camp in ⟦E4⟧ and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:984:details:0: Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in ⟦E16⟧, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.
rows.quest:984:details:1: BI have seen a couple hints of corruption in ⟦E4⟧ already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
rows.quest:984:completion:1: BWith the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.
rows.quest:985:obj:0: Kill 8 Blackwood Pathfinders and 5 Windtalkers and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:985:details:0: You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, ⟦24⟧. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?
rows.quest:985:details:1: BNot all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.
rows.quest:985:details:2: BIf you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
rows.quest:985:completion:0: Wash the blood from your garments, ⟦25⟧, and do not mourn what you had to do. Instead, give thanks. You have lessened the threat to our people here in Auberdine, even if ⟦E4⟧ is still in jeopardy from the effects of fel moss.
rows.quest:986:obj:0: Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts and return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:986:details:0: ⟦26⟧, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by ⟦E4⟧'s creatures while you look for him.
rows.quest:986:details:1: BTo create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:986:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦27⟧. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.
rows.quest:986:completion:1: BGive me a few moments, then return to me.
rows.quest:986:completion:2: BOh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
rows.quest:993:obj:0: Find Volcor in ⟦E4⟧ and give him the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak.
rows.quest:993:details:0: The cloak is complete, ⟦28⟧. The time has come to find Volcor. I can only hope we are in time.
rows.quest:993:details:1: BThe cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. It will be up to you to know when to use it: I would suggest waiting until you find Grimclaw.
rows.quest:993:details:2: BIf what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. Grimclaw will be alongside the road waiting for you. Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
rows.quest:993:completion:0: Wonderful! Terenthis found someone to help me.
rows.quest:993:completion:1: BAnd look. a moonstalker cloak...⟦29⟧ Oh... that hurts. Thank you, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:993:completion:2: BThe furbolgs wounded me before I managed to evade them. Give me a moment, and I should be fine to talk some more.
rows.quest:994:obj:0: Protect Volcor until you reach the road, then speak to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:994:details:0: All right, ⟦31⟧, force it is. Let's get out of here as soon as you're ready. We'll fight our way down to the road--Grimclaw should still be there. Once there, we can part ways.
rows.quest:994:details:1: BTerenthis will want to hear your version of the story immediately, so head to Auberdine after we make it out of here.
rows.quest:994:completion:0: ⟦32⟧! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in ⟦E4⟧ and beyond.
rows.quest:995:obj:0: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:995:details:0: All right then... if you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. Let us leave when you're ready.
rows.quest:995:details:1: BRemember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.
rows.quest:995:completion:0: ⟦33⟧! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in ⟦E4⟧ and beyond.
rows.quest:1001:obj:0: Collect 3 Thresher Eyes from ⟦E4⟧ Threshers in the deep sea near Buzzbox 411.
rows.quest:1001:details:0: A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.
rows.quest:1001:details:1: B"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach
rows.quest:1001:details:2: BSo, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that...
rows.quest:1001:details:3: BJust like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
rows.quest:1001:completion:0: The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.
rows.quest:1001:completion:2: B"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"
rows.quest:1001:completion:3: BYou believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.
rows.quest:1002:obj:0: Collect 6 Moonstalker Fangs and place them in Buzzbox 323.
rows.quest:1002:details:0: The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.
rows.quest:1002:details:1: B"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."
rows.quest:1002:details:2: BWizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.
rows.quest:1002:details:3: B"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
rows.quest:1002:completion:0: The Buzzbox suddenly leaps into action, and you can hear the distinct sounds of teeth being ground to dust coming from within.
rows.quest:1002:completion:1: B"Sho, ya made it! Thatsh exshellent newsh... Sho... Why doncha move along? Oh! Unless you want another job!"
rows.quest:1003:obj:0: Collect 4 Grizzled Scalps from Grizzled Thistle Bears to the south of Auberdine and place them in Buzzbox 525.
rows.quest:1003:details:0: Over the boiling noises and dripping sounds coming from the machine, you hear Wizbang's wavering voice call out.
rows.quest:1003:details:1: B"Nexsht onesh far south down the road. Shouldn't be hard to find... jusht off to the shide... near a fensh. I think I hid it in shum bushesh... Bushessh. Hehehe... Yesh, Buzzbox 525 takes grizzled scalps from thoshe grizzled thistle bears. Boy thash a mouthful. Grizzshled... Hehehe..."
rows.quest:1003:details:2: BYou hear more gulping sounds as the machine cuts out. Then, suddenly, it bursts back to life.
rows.quest:1003:completion:0: "Sho yash gotsh the scalps in? That'sh sho great... Wha? Well, yesh I shuppose ya have realized that I can speaksh to ya without the materials in the machine. But I was telling the truth when I shaid they were broken!
rows.quest:1003:completion:1: BSee, in addition to being communimacation toolsh, the Buzzboxes also brew and distill fine liquor. Shorry for any deceptshion, but the nightelves do not apprecimerate my liquor trade in their townsh. I put shomething special in thish box to show my gratitude for yer effortsh. Enjoy!"
rows.quest:1133:obj:0: Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1133:details:0: If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... go to Astranaar. I'm sure an eager member of the ⟦E17⟧ such as you can do some real good there. Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.
rows.quest:1133:details:1: BBut don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...
rows.quest:1133:completion:0: You are here to offer your services to the ⟦E17⟧, ⟦34⟧? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... ⟦E9⟧ Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
rows.quest:1138:obj:0: Collect 6 Fine Crab Chunks for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1138:details:0: I love crab. Crabs are the fruit of the sea! You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it. They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried. There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and ⟦E2⟧ surprise crab. That's... that's about it.
rows.quest:1138:details:1: BI'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks. You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers. You can make a lot with it. You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
rows.quest:1138:completion:0: Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need. Thanks ⟦35⟧! I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it. Maybe you can do something with it. It sure don't make any good crab dishes.
rows.quest:1138:completion:1: BI told you all about crabs, right?
rows.quest:1140:obj:0: Free the trapped Highborne souls in Night Run and Satyrnaar, then return to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:1140:details:0: The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my enemies.
rows.quest:1140:details:1: BFrom Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1140:details:2: BBe careful out there, ⟦36⟧, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned ⟦37⟧ such as yourself.
rows.quest:1140:completion:0: Perhaps the satyrs have been allowed to persist in the forest for too long. I will speak with Elissa about it when next I travel to Auberdine.
rows.quest:1140:completion:1: BNonetheless, with the soulgems destroyed, Athrikus' power will be greatly diminished. We must seize on this opportunity to eliminate him and his cult.
